item.title: STRANGER THINGS Finale Alternate Ending Seems to Have Been Much More Definitive
item.description: Fans have been debating about the Stranger Things finale for the last two weeks, and with viewers split on the fate of the main character, I am sure we will forever be on one side or the other, but The Duffer Brothers seem to have veered in the direction of the choose-your-own-adventure ending late in the game. The show ended with its fifth season, which the creators had been building toward over the last nine years. But not every detail was set in stone going into the final season’s production.
